claim: Web Summit Lisbon runs from 9 to 12 November.
Invest.Rio and Maravalley are taking ten startups to Web Summit Lisbon, the second year they have done so.
Startups.com.br reported the open call on 18 September 2026.
The call was for startups under six years old with fewer than 100 employees.
Gol pays the tickets for the ten startups.
Gol's Rio to Lisbon route from Galeão, its first intercontinental route, begins five flights a week from 24 November 2026.
Startups.com.br named the ten startups on 26 October 2026.
Correio da Manhã reported the same ten startups on 25 October.
Maravalley ran a mission to VivaTech in Paris in June 2026 with Business France's delegation.
Sebrae says 12 Brazilian states run their own missions to this year's Web Summit.
Nine of the ten startups are from Brazil and sheerME is from Portugal.
Bizuu and AllPetSenior speak in the Startup Showcase.
